name: Gmail Email — Read
author: hearth-team
description: Read email from your Gmail inbox via Google OAuth. action='digest' returns recent mail WITH content (sender, subject, snippet) in one call — ideal for a morning brief; also search (ids), get (one message body), labels. Uses the minimum-privilege gmail.readonly scope — this skill physically cannot send email or modify your mailbox. Pair with Gmail Email — Send for outbound.

vault_inputs.label: Google OAuth client ID
vault_inputs.help: One-time setup: console.cloud.google.com → APIs & Services → Library → enable 'Gmail API' → Credentials → Create Credentials → OAuth client ID → type 'Web application' → add http://localhost:3000/oauth/callback as an Authorized redirect URI (used by the one-click Connect button). Paste the Client ID here. Same client serves all Google skills.

vault_inputs.label: Google OAuth client secret
vault_inputs.help: The 'Client secret' shown next to the Client ID in the Cloud Console Credentials list. Stored encrypted in your vault. If you ever rotate it, paste the new value here and click Save.

vault_inputs.label: Gmail read refresh token (manual fallback)
vault_inputs.help: OPTIONAL — the 'Connect Google' button above does this in one click. Manual path: developers.google.com/oauthplayground → gear icon → 'Use your own OAuth credentials' → paste Client ID + secret → Step 1: tick ONLY https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly (keeps this token read-only) → Authorize → Step 2: Exchange authorization code → copy the Refresh token here.
